text:
maria_pm: Heads-up: new RFP asks for a medium-tier 'elastic commitment' with monthly commit but with transferable burst credits across org units. They want trading of unused credits internally. Need quick decision on whether to allow transferability.

sam_sales: Customer says transferability reduces waste. They want credits pooled across 3 teams under one account and the ability to shift credits week-to-week.

oscar_finance: Transferability increases forecasting complexity and churn risk. Recommend limited transferability: transfer within an account up to X% of commit each month, no transfer outside legal entity, and audit trail. Also recommend a monthly rebalancing window.

lena_legal: If we allow transfers, contract must specify boundaries: eligible accounts, audit logs, and constraints (no third-party transfers). Add clause that transfers don't change billing obligations for the committed entity.

tony_eng: Implementation: add account-level ledger for credits and a transfer API. We can support it but need a billing team change and UI for audit. Estimate 3 sprints to build + 1 for billing integration.

maria_pm: Proposed packaging: 'Elastic Commit (Transferable)' SKU - $30k/mo commit, included burst pool = 1.2x baseline, account-level transferable credits up to 20% of commit monthly, 20% rollover cap, overage @2x. Pilot term 6 months. Require org admin to authorize transfers.

sam_sales: Call it 'pooled surge credits' in sales materials. Customer wants a simple example and admin UX.

oscar_finance: Add internal alert when transferred credits >15% in a month and require AM sign-off if transfer >30%. Also recommend no rollover for transferred credits beyond 1 month.

lena_legal: I'll draft language for transfer constraints, data retention for audit, and admin consent requirement.

tony_eng: I'll prototype API + ledger schema and flag it behind an enterprise feature flag. Also wire a usage dashboard for transferred credits.

maria_pm: Action items: Lena -> contract snippets (Wed); Tony -> API prototype and estimation (Wed); Oscar -> financial guardrails + alert thresholds (Thu); Sam -> customer-facing one-pager + UX asks (Thu). Sync Fri 2pm PT.

sam_sales: I'll loop in the customer's admin and PM to validate they actually need per-week transfers; sometimes monthly pooling is enough.

oscar_finance: Agree. Transferability seems feasible with guardrails but needs careful monitoring.

maria_pm: We'll present this as a conditional feature: available for Dedicated and Private customers only during pilot. Keep hosted API out for now. Thanks all.
